channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wes Unseld | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wes Unseld from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Wes Unseld
item.description:
Beal says as much now.

“We still have to develop as a team and get better, but [I’m confident we’ll get there]. It was Wes Unseld’s first year last year, so that was an adjustment for us as players, getting acclimated to a new system and how he wants us to play. We have about 10 new guys since the start of last year, so essentially we’re playing with a fresh new team.”

Bradley Beal on Wes Unseld, Aug 26, 2022. Source: Haute Living Magazine.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Wes Unseld
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on who has the bragging rights between the Silas & Unseld families:

“They split the finals. Washington won..in ‘78. Seattle won..in ‘79. Big Wes made it to the Hall of Fame. So I guess big Wes is the leader,but hopefully my dad will make it to the HOF at some point.”

Stephen Silas on Wes Unseld, Oct 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Ishmael Smith on Wes Unseld
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Ish Smith on wearing the 41 Wes Unseld patch:

“Words can't describe how great he was as a man, as a Wizard and as a player.”

Ishmael Smith on Wes Unseld, Jul 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Wes Unseld
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on the Wizards wearing a patch with the late Wes Unseld’s number on their jersey:

“I think it’s awesome. I think it’s well deserved. He is the greatest player in franchise history.”

Scott Brooks on Wes Unseld, Jul 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.
